Gas powered vehicles were the only ones that were working and could get around and navigate the terrain for three months - plus we could siphon gas from spare vehicles to have enough fuel for our generators each day, to keep what food we had from spoiling. It made a lasting impression and I doubt anything could convince me to go fully electric or even hybrid.
